name: siftivo
description: Book recommendations that start from the books you loved.

interface.longDescription:
Book recommendations that start from the books you loved.

Name a few books you loved and one you didn't, and get your next book with the reason it fits. Describe a mood in your own words, or ask what to read after the book you just finished. Connect your Siftivo account and it keeps the books you name, leaves out ones you have already read, logs what you start and finish with your rating, and posts your review in your own words when you ask. Look up any series in reading order, see what a book is about, and see the books moving most this week on the Siftivo Reading Index. Catalog lookups work without an account.
defaultPrompt: I loved Piranesi and Circe. What else would I like?
What order do the Murderbot books go in?

positive.description: Books like ones the reader loved, no account needed
positive.prompt: I loved Piranesi and Circe. What else would I like?
positive.expected_behavior: Both titles resolve (Piranesi by Susanna Clarke, Circe by Madeline Miller) and nothing comes back as unmatched. Five recommendations by other authors, each with title, author, year and a siftivo.com link. No Susanna Clarke or Madeline Miller books in the results.

positive.description: A series in reading order, no account needed
positive.prompt: What order do the Murderbot books go in?
positive.expected_behavior: The Murderbot Diaries by Martha Wells in reading order, starting with All Systems Red (2017), then Artificial Condition, Rogue Protocol, Exit Strategy and Network Effect, with each book's position and year. Novellas sit at their half positions (for example Home at 4.5).

positive.description: What is popular this week, no account needed
positive.expected_behavior: The current week of the Siftivo Reading Index: a dated fiction chart and a nonfiction chart, each ranked, with weeks on chart and new entries marked. The titles change weekly.

positive.prompt: What's on my reading shelves right now?
positive.expected_behavior: The test account's books grouped by shelf (reading, finished, want to read), with the account's ratings on finished books and progress on the book being read. Only books actually on the account's shelves; nothing invented.

positive.description: Shelve a book, then confirm it
positive.prompt: Add Piranesi to my want-to-read list, then check it's there.
positive.expected_behavior: search_books finds Piranesi by Susanna Clarke. add_to_library saves it to the Want to read shelf; ChatGPT may ask to confirm first, since the tool writes to the account. get_my_book then reports Piranesi on the shelf with status NOT_STARTED. Running it twice leaves one entry.

negative.description: Buying a book. Siftivo is a catalog and reading log, not a store, and holds no prices, stock or retailer inventory.
negative.prompt: Where can I buy Piranesi cheapest, and is it in stock?

negative.description: Film and streaming. The prompt names a book, but Siftivo holds nothing about adaptations or where to stream them.
negative.prompt: Is there a Piranesi movie yet, and what can I stream it on?

negative.description: Someone else's library. The account tools only read the signed-in reader's own shelves.
negative.prompt: What is my friend Sarah reading on Siftivo right now?

review.commerce_description: Siftivo does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Listing text now says a reader can post a review. Tool changes since 1.0.5 arrived through the daily scan: write_review and delete_review are new, get_my_book returns the reader's review, and a rating alone on a book not on a shelf no longer shelves it. No change to sign-in or test cases.
